articles.headline: James Harden scores a season-high 32 points as the Cavaliers beat the Knicks 115-107
articles.description: — James Harden scored a season-high 32 points, more than double his average during a tough start to 2026-27, and the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the New York Knicks 115-107 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Celtics win 5th straight, overcoming 22-point deficit to beat Raptors 98-93
articles.description: — Jayson Tatum made the tying and go-ahead free throws with 25.2 seconds remaining and the Boston Celtics overcame a 22-point deficit to beat the Toronto Raptors 98-93 on Wednesday night, extending their winning streak to five.
